capabilities: Register rendered callouts as concept records with names and aliases
Link selected terms or aliases to concepts via commands and context menu
Rewrite vault-wide block links when a callout moves to another note
Browse and edit concept records in an auto-created Obsidian Base
Match aliases as regular expressions for plurals and phrasings
disambiguation: Not a general wiki or knowledge-graph tool; it only indexes callout blocks that have a title and links text to them.
extras: Installed via BRAT or by manually copying files; no community plugin store listing mentioned. Records are plain Markdown files that remain usable without the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn titled callouts into a searchable concept database or to link terms in notes to the callout that defines them.
summary: Concept index plugin that registers callout blocks (definitions, theorems) as concepts and links matching terms across the vault.
